description: NBT paths index byte and int arrays, set, insert and remove their elements, and insert several values in order

steps.cmd: data modify block 56 100 263 Items[0].tag.I[1] set value 25
data modify block 56 100 263 Items[0].tag.I[] set value 7
data modify block 56 100 263 Items[0].tag.B[0] set value "x"
steps.expect_error: must be set to a number

steps.cmd: data modify block 56 100 263 Items[0].tag.B append value 4b
data modify block 56 100 263 Items[0].tag.B prepend value 0b
data modify block 56 100 263 Items[0].tag.B insert 2 value 9b
data modify block 56 100 263 Items[0].tag.B insert -1 value 5b
data modify block 56 100 263 Items[0].tag.B insert 9 value 1b
data modify block 56 100 263 Items[0].tag.L set value ["a","b"]
data modify block 56 100 263 Items[0].tag.L insert 0 from block 56 100 263 Items[0].tag.L
data modify block 56 100 263 Items[0].tag.I append from block 56 100 263 Items[0].tag.B
